meta.themes: Defense AI, Agentic Workflows, AI Infrastructure, Enterprise Adoption

news.title: Anthropic sued the U.S. government over its Pentagon supply-chain-risk designation
news.summary: Reuters reported Anthropic escalated its dispute with the U.S. government, arguing the designation punished the company for refusing to weaken AI safeguards for defense use.

news.title: Thinking Machines Lab secured capital and a long-term Nvidia chip supply agreement
news.summary: Reuters said Mira Murati's startup paired fresh funding with a multi-year Nvidia partnership, showing how top AI labs are locking in compute access early.

news.title: Nvidia-backed Nscale reached a $14.6 billion valuation in a new funding round
news.summary: Reuters reported Nscale raised $2 billion, underscoring continued investor appetite for AI infrastructure firms that sit below the model layer.

news.title: AMD deepened AI memory talks with Samsung as accelerator demand kept climbing
news.summary: Reuters reported Lisa Su was set to meet Samsung leadership on HBM supply and broader AI chip cooperation, reinforcing that memory remains a strategic bottleneck.

news.title: Amazon agreed to offer Cerebras AI chips through AWS
news.summary: Reuters said Cerebras struck a cloud deal with Amazon, giving enterprises another path to rent non-Nvidia accelerators at scale.

news.title: Software vendors pushed back on the idea that AI will wipe out their category
news.summary: Reuters covered enterprise software leaders arguing AI changes packaging and workflows more than it eliminates core systems of record.

news.title: Canal+ signed Google and OpenAI deals for AI video production and recommendations
news.summary: Reuters reported a media-sector example of generative AI moving from pilots into multi-year operating agreements tied to content workflows.

news.title: Amazon began shifting defense workloads while keeping Claude available for other use cases
news.summary: Reuters reported AWS started transitioning some Department of War workloads off Anthropic systems while maintaining broader Claude availability.

news.title: GitHub shipped major agentic improvements for Copilot in JetBrains IDEs
news.summary: GitHub added custom agents, sub-agents, and stronger workflow support for JetBrains users, extending Copilot beyond single-turn chat into deeper IDE-native automation.

news.title: GitHub detailed the security architecture behind its agentic workflows
news.summary: GitHub described its MCP gateway isolation, credential handling, and staged-write model, offering concrete patterns for safer enterprise agent deployment.

news.title: Anthropic launched the Anthropic Institute to study societal impacts of powerful AI
news.summary: Anthropic announced a new research effort focused on labor, geopolitics, and governance questions around advanced AI systems.

news.title: Anthropic committed $100 million to expand its Claude Partner Network
news.summary: Anthropic said it would invest heavily in implementation and services partners, signaling a more aggressive enterprise go-to-market push around Claude.
